steps.en: The owner check runs after the fee and payment reference are set
steps.id: Pengecekan owner jalan setelah fee dan payment reference dibuat
steps.why_en: The check runs right after the notice is created, before any fee, and no payment reference exists.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan jalan tepat setelah notice dibuat, sebelum ada fee, dan payment reference tidak ada.

steps.en: Notices waiting for the owner check are sent to the vehicle registry
steps.id: Notice yang menunggu pengecekan owner dikirim ke registri kendaraan
steps.why_en: Foreign vehicles and suspended notices are left out, and the send itself cannot be seen from the code.
steps.why_id: Kendaraan asing dan notice yang disuspend dikecualikan, dan pengirimannya tidak terlihat dari code.

steps.en: The returned owner ID, name and type are saved on the notice
steps.id: ID, nama, dan tipe owner yang kembali disimpan di notice
steps.why_en: Only found vehicles are saved, and some notices lost their owner lookup after go-live.
steps.why_id: Hanya kendaraan yang ditemukan yang disimpan, dan sebagian notice kehilangan hasil pencarian owner setelah go-live.

steps.en: OCMS knows the owner IDs and can follow up with them
steps.id: OCMS tahu ID owner dan bisa menindaklanjutinya
steps.why_en: Notices move on when the file is sent, so some proceeded with no owner ID.
steps.why_id: Notice lanjut saat file dikirim, jadi sebagian berjalan tanpa ID owner.
